ألتحق (form VIII)
# أَلْتَحِقُ (ʔaltaḥiqu) /ʔal.ta.ħi.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
# أُلْتَحَقُ (ʔultaḥaqu) /ʔul.ta.ħa.qu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
# أَلْتَحِقَ (ʔaltaḥiqa) /ʔal.ta.ħi.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
# أُلْتَحَقَ (ʔultaḥaqa) /ʔul.ta.ħa
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
